subject: Roles at Halvorsen Robotics + how our process works
body:
Hi Alex,

I lead technical recruiting at Halvorsen Robotics and noticed your robotics projects. We currently have openings for a Controls Engineer and a Firmware Engineer. Our process is usually a recruiter chat, a technical interview, and a short assessment. If either role sounds interesting, reply and I'll send details.

Best,
Yusuf Demir
